stories.topic: Trump says he will create an AI Force and name an AI czar
stories.script: President Trump said Saturday he is creating an A.I. Force, comparing it to Space Force from his first term, and plans to name an artificial intelligence czar in the near future. In a Truth Social post, he said the administration will not hinder the growth of the industry and will rely on existing criminal and civil law to police misconduct. Fox News reports he did not detail the Force's structure, authority, or timeline, and named no candidate for the czar role.

stories.topic: Trump order weighs H-1B employer layoffs of American workers
stories.script: President Trump signed an executive order on September eighteenth directing the Departments of State, Labor, and Homeland Security to weigh whether an H-one-B sponsor laid off similarly situated American workers in the previous year, or plans future layoffs, when reviewing labor condition applications, petitions, visas, and admissions. The White House said the order aims to tighten program integrity and interagency coordination. It does not automatically bar employers from using H-one-B visas, but signals heightened scrutiny where workforce cuts overlap with sponsored roles, according to coverage citing the order and IANS reporting.

reporters.signoff: I am Edith, for GLC News.
